style_suffix: STYLE: one consistent series of soft, warm, realistic painted illustrations in the spirit of the artwork in Jehovah's Witnesses' publications on jw.org, made to BLEND INTO a printed wall chart on cream paper (#f7f6f2), not to stand out. Subject centred and compact with generous soft margins; the background becomes lighter, simpler and paler toward every edge and fades into plain cream paper colour at the borders, so the picture can be vignetted or feathered into the page. No hard borders or frames, no saturated colours, no busy or dark backgrounds, no black skies: render night, storm and fire scenes as soft warm dusk tones. Believable people with natural expressions; historically accurate ancient Middle-Eastern settings, clothing, tools and architecture for the period; modest dress for everyone (long robes, covered shoulders). Respectful and dignified; violence implied, never graphic, no blood or gore. Never show Jehovah God as a human or any figure: his presence is only soft brilliant light, glory or a throne in radiance. When Jesus appears, depict him as jw.org art does: a Middle-Eastern Jewish man about 30, short dark-brown hair, short neat beard, kind face, plain tunic and mantle. NO halos, NO crosses or crucifixes, NO religious icons, NO text, letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos or watermarks anywhere. Print quality.
